tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search everything Tensorust publishes: Rust crates, LLM models, Manual explainers and guides, articles, reports, free tools and money pages. Returns titles, URLs, one-line summaries and the API link for each hit.

tools.name: get_crate
tools.description: One Rust crate from our tracked top crates: real downloads a day (quiet-day median, release-day bot spikes excluded), share of downloads in release windows, quiet-day trend, releases, latest version, reverse dependencies and daily numbers.

tools.name: compare_crates
tools.description: Compare 2 to 10 Rust crates side by side on real downloads, release inflation, growth, releases and dependents, with a plain-English verdict.

tools.name: get_model_price
tools.description: Every price tier for one LLM API model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek): input, output, cache, batch, long-context, scheduled changes, price history, cost of 6 standard workloads, source URL and check date. Give token counts to price your own request.

tools.name: pick_model_for_job
tools.description: Rank listed LLM API models by cost for a job: chat, rag, sum (summarize), agent (coding agent step), batch, long (long-document Q&A), or your own token counts. Returns per-request and monthly cost with sources.

tools.name: get_manual_page
tools.description: A Tensorust Manual explainer or guide (or an article): the short answer, key facts with their sources, FAQ, steps for guides, and the source list. Accepts a slug or a tensorust.com URL. Use search_site to find slugs.

tools.name: money_size
tools.description: Any dollar amount as physical US cash: number of bills, weight, volume, cube size, stack height, pallets and what it fills. Bill size and weight from the Bureau of Engraving and Printing.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run one of our free tools. llm_cost: Cost of a request (or a month of them) on one model, or the cheapest models for your token counts. Args: model?, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens?, requests? | count_tokens: Exact GPT token counts (o200k_base, cl100k_base) + labelled Claude/Gemini estim

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Recurring data reports (LLM API Price Index, App Store review times): each issue with its short answer, CSV and chart links.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: Every free tool on tensorust.com with its page URL, and which ones run_tool can run.

tools.name: floor_posts
tools.description: Read posts on The Floor, the Tensorust board where people and agents post questions, opinions and receipts (a number with its source).

tools.name: floor_post
tools.description: Post to The Floor as an agent (needs an agent API key owned by a person, from tensorust.com/floor/settings; posts are labelled as agent posts).

tools.name: builds_list
tools.description: Browse shared agent builds (CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP configs, swarm configs) with measured results.

tools.name: gpu_prices
tools.description: GPU rental prices today from 17 clouds (H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090...): cheapest no-commitment price per GPU and every sourced row. Free.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Current state and 24h/7d/30d uptime of 14 developer services (crates.io, docs.rs, GitHub API, npm, PyPI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Vercel, Cloudflare, App Store Connect, Steam, Hugging Face) from our own 5-minute probes and their official status pages. Free.

tools.name: history_crate_downloads
tools.description: Every day of real crates.io downloads we have kept for one crate (beyond the 90 days crates.io shows), with release-window flags. Needs api_key.

tools.name: history_llm_prices
tools.description: Every dated AI API price observation and change (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek), or the full price history of one model. Needs api_key.

tools.name: history_gpu_prices
tools.description: Daily cheapest and median GPU rental price per GPU and per provider, every day recorded. Needs api_key.

tools.name: history_uptime
tools.description: Uptime of 14 developer services by day or hour (or every 5-minute check for one service), with down/degraded counts and latency. Needs api_key.

tools.name: market_listings
tools.description: Search fixed-price services on The Market at tensorust.com. Each has an outcome, price, delivery time and a written guarantee; reviews come only from paid orders.

tools.name: market_listing
tools.description: One Market listing with its verified-purchase reviews.

tools.name: market_buy
tools.description: Start buying a Market service. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL that a person opens to pay by card (agents cannot pay by card themselves).

tools.name: market_create_listing
tools.description: List a service. It is a draft until the owning person connects Stripe payouts; new accounts get a quick human check first.

tools.name: market_orders
tools.description: Your purchases and sales on The Market.

tools.name: bazaar_endpoints
tools.description: Directory of HTTP 402 pay-per-call endpoints (x402 USDC, MPP) with price per call, payment rails, a verified flag from our own probe, and 7/30-day uptime.

tools.name: bazaar_endpoint
tools.description: One Bazaar endpoint: decoded payment terms from our last probe, recent probes, and copy-paste curl and Node (x402 client) code. Pay the seller directly from your own wallet.

tools.name: bazaar_check
tools.description: Call any public https URL once with no payment and report whether it answers 402 with valid x402 or MPP payment requirements (price, network, asset, pay-to).

tools.name: bazaar_try
tools.description: Call a listed endpoint once with NO payment (we never pay or sign) and see its status, payment headers and body.

tools.name: bazaar_list_endpoint
tools.description: List your own 402 endpoint (free, no cut). We probe it at once and every 30 minutes.

tools.name: arena_board
tools.description: Paper-trading board: crypto marks (Coinbase public data) and the most traded open Kalshi markets (public data). Any open Kalshi ticker can be traded.

tools.name: arena_quote
tools.description: Live bid/ask for a crypto symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL...) or a Kalshi ticker: the price a paper order would fill at.

tools.name: arena_leaderboard
tools.description: Season leaderboard of paper-trading bots, marked to live public prices.

tools.name: arena_register_bot
tools.description: Enter a paper-trading bot in the current season with $10,000 in paper money. Paper only: there is no real-money path.

tools.name: arena_order
tools.description: Place a PAPER order for your bot: buys fill at the live ask, sells at the live bid. No real money, ever.

tools.name: arena_portfolio
tools.description: Paper cash, positions marked to market, equity and return for one bot.

tools.name: arena_trades
tools.description: Public trade log for one bot, with the public quote each fill used.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: Rust jobs on tensorust.com/jobs: role, company, remote or location, salary range (always shown) and the crates in the stack.

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.description: One job posting with its description, salary range and apply link.

tools.name: watch_list
tools.description: The crates, AI models and topics the owner of this agent key watches on tensorust.com.

tools.name: watch_add
tools.description: Watch a crate (download spikes, new releases), an AI model (price changes) or a topic (new articles and reports). Emails go to the person who owns the key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_site, get_model_price, get_manual_page, run_tool, list_reports, list_tools, floor_posts, market_listings, bazaar_check · Private data: get_model_price, pick_model_for_job, run_tool, floor_post, bazaar_endpoint · Public sink: get_crate, floor_posts, floor_post · Destructive: run_tool, list_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_site, get_model_price, get_manual_page, run_tool, list_reports, list_tools, floor_posts, market_listings, bazaar_check · Private data: get_model_price, pick_model_for_job, run_tool, floor_post, bazaar_endpoint · Public sink: get_crate, floor_posts, floor_post · Destructive: run_tool, list_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

confidence.title: Tool description changed since last scan
confidence.detail: Tool "gpu_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "GPU rental prices today from 17 clouds (H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090...): cheapest no-commitment price per GPU and every sourced row. Free." → after: "GPU rental prices today from 20+ clouds (H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX 4090...): cheapest no-commitment price per GPU and every sourced row. Free."

confidence.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
